blocks.raw: # CP Codes and Reporting Groups Tool Documentation
blocks.text: CP Codes and Reporting Groups Tool Documentation

blocks.raw: > Akamai's CP Codes and Reporting Groups tool lets you create, edit, view, and delete reporting groups. You can get access to detailed information about CP codes, edit their parameters, and group them for billing purposes.
